question: 包裹比预计日期晚到，顾客给这一单的评分通常会低多少？

延误定义.default_basis: 沿用第三组 Report §2.4 自然日主口径；完整时点为敏感性比较。

labels.calendar: 按自然日，当天签收算准时
labels.clock: 按完整时间戳，晚于预计时刻算晚送

checks.orders 的主键完整且唯一: SELECT order_id,count(*) FROM orders GROUP BY order_id HAVING count(*)>1 OR order_id IS NULL
checks.items 的主键完整且唯一: SELECT order_id,order_item_id,count(*) FROM items GROUP BY order_id,order_item_id HAVING count(*)>1 OR order_id IS NULL OR order_item_id IS NULL
checks.payments 的主键完整且唯一: SELECT order_id,payment_sequential,count(*) FROM payments GROUP BY order_id,payment_sequential HAVING count(*)>1 OR order_id IS NULL OR payment_sequential IS NULL
checks.items 每条明细有主单: select rowid,order_id from items where order_id is null or not exists (select 1 from orders o where o.order_id=items.order_id)
checks.payments 每条明细有主单: select rowid,order_id from payments where order_id is null or not exists (select 1 from orders o where o.order_id=payments.order_id)
checks.reviews 每条明细有主单: select rowid,order_id from reviews where order_id is null or not exists (select 1 from orders o where o.order_id=reviews.order_id)

exports.结构.csv: select 'orders' source,count(*) source_rows,count(distinct order_id) orders from orders union all select 'items' source,count(*) source_rows,count(distinct order_id) orders from items union all select 'payments' source,count(*) source_rows,count(distinct order_id) orders from payments union all select 'reviews' source,count(*) source_rows,count(distinct order_id) orders from reviews

done.title: 为什么订单数和商品记录数对不上？
done.body: 把四份文件想成四本账。同一笔购物在订单账上记一次；买两件商品，商品账上就会有两行。下面最后一列是每本账里能找到多少个不同的订单号。

tables.sql: select '订单' 来源关系,'一笔订单' 每行代表,count(*) 原表行数,count(distinct order_id) 覆盖订单 from orders union all select '├ 商品' 来源关系,'一条商品明细' 每行代表,count(*) 原表行数,count(distinct order_id) 覆盖订单 from items union all select '├ 支付' 来源关系,'一次支付' 每行代表,count(*) 原表行数,count(distinct order_id) 覆盖订单 from payments union all select '└ 评价' 来源关系,'一条评价' 每行代表,count(*) 原表行数,count(distinct order_id) 覆盖订单 from reviews
select order_id 订单号,count(*) 支付次数 from payments group by order_id having count(*)>1 limit 3

done.lesson: 下一步用订单号把四本账对起来。一个订单最终只占一行，买得多的顾客也只算一单。

checks.订单主键集合及行数一致: select order_id from orders except select order_id from base
checks.每单至多一行: select order_id from base group by order_id having count(*)!=1
checks.评分在1至5: select rowid,review_score from reviews where review_score is null or review_score not between 1 and 5
checks.item_cents 守恒: select sum(item_cents) from base having sum(item_cents) != (select sum(cast(round(price*100) as integer)) from items)
checks.freight_cents 守恒: select sum(freight_cents) from base having sum(freight_cents) != (select sum(cast(round(freight_value*100) as integer)) from items)
checks.paid_cents 守恒: select sum(paid_cents) from base having sum(paid_cents) != (select sum(cast(round(payment_value*100) as integer)) from payments)

exports.匹配对账.csv: select count(*) orders,sum(item_n is null) no_item,sum(payment_n is null) no_payment,sum(review_n is null) no_review,sum(item_cents) item_cents,sum(freight_cents) freight_cents,sum(paid_cents) paid_cents from base
exports.连接诊断.csv: select b.order_id,b.item_n,b.payment_n,b.paid_cents as verified_cents,sum(cast(round(p.payment_value*100) as integer)) as naive_cents from base b join items i using(order_id) join payments p using(order_id) where b.item_n=2 and b.payment_n=2 group by b.order_id,b.item_n,b.payment_n,b.paid_cents order by b.order_id limit 5

candidates.name: 直接连接商品与支付明细（教学候选）
sql: create table it as select order_id,count(*) item_n,sum(cast(round(price*100) as integer)) item_cents,sum(cast(round(freight_value*100) as integer)) freight_cents from items group by order_id
create table pay as select order_id,count(*) payment_n,sum(cast(round(payment_value*100) as integer)) paid_cents from payments group by order_id
create table rev as select order_id,count(*) review_n,avg(cast(review_score as integer)) score from reviews group by order_id

create table base as select o.*,item_n,item_cents,freight_cents,payment_n,paid_cents,review_n,score from orders o left join items using(order_id) left join payments using(order_id) left join it using(order_id) left join pay using(order_id) left join rev using(order_id)

candidates.name: 分别汇总明细后连接
sql: create table it as select order_id,count(*) item_n,sum(cast(round(price*100) as integer)) item_cents,sum(cast(round(freight_value*100) as integer)) freight_cents from items group by order_id
create table pay as select order_id,count(*) payment_n,sum(cast(round(payment_value*100) as integer)) paid_cents from payments group by order_id
create table rev as select order_id,count(*) review_n,avg(cast(review_score as integer)) score from reviews group by order_id

create table base as select o.*,item_n,item_cents,freight_cents,payment_n,paid_cents,review_n,score from orders o left join it using(order_id) left join pay using(order_id) left join rev using(order_id)

rejected.title: 买了两件商品，怎么会多算一倍的钱？
rejected.body:
程序刚试着把商品和支付明细直接拼起来。下面这单买了两件商品、付了两次款；每次支付都跟两件商品配了一遍。
金额单位为巴西雷亚尔。

tables.sql: with chosen as (select order_id from base where item_n=2 and payment_n=2 group by order_id having count(*)>1 order by order_id limit 1), pairs as (select i.order_id,i.order_item_id item,p.payment_sequential seq,p.payment_value amount from chosen join items i using(order_id) join payments p using(order_id)) select count(*) 连接行数,(select round(paid_cents/100.0,2) from pay where order_id=pairs.order_id) 买家实付,round(sum(amount),2) 错误合计 from pairs group by order_id

with chosen as (select order_id from base where item_n=2 and payment_n=2 group by order_id having count(*)>1 order by order_id limit 1), pairs as (select i.order_id,i.order_item_id item,p.payment_sequential seq,p.payment_value amount from chosen join items i using(order_id) join payments p using(order_id)) select item 商品序号,seq 支付序号,amount 支付金额 from pairs order by item,seq

rejected.lesson: 下一步撤销这次拼接。先给每笔订单算一个支付总额，再将总额放回订单。

done.title: 改完以后，每笔订单还在吗？
done.body: 程序已经把商品和支付分别加总，再按订单号拼回去。现在做两次点数，再把所有支付和原账核对。

tables.sql: select count(*) 合并行数,count(distinct order_id) 不同订单数,sum(paid_cents)-(select sum(cast(round(payment_value*100) as integer)) from payments) 支付差额_分 from base

done.lesson: 两次点数相同，支付差额为零。接下来要判断这些订单什么时候送到。

stages.name: 3 质量标记
sql: create table quality as select *,case when order_status is null then 'status_unknown' when order_status!='delivered' then 'outside_delivered' when order_delivered_customer_date is null then 'missing_actual' when order_delivered_customer_date<order_purchase_timestamp then 'negative_duration' when order_purchase_timestamp is null or order_estimated_delivery_date is null then 'missing_reference' else 'eligible' end quality from base

checks.order_purchase_timestamp 时间可解析: select order_id,order_purchase_timestamp from base where order_purchase_timestamp is not null and try_cast(order_purchase_timestamp as timestamp) is null
checks.order_delivered_customer_date 时间可解析: select order_id,order_delivered_customer_date from base where order_delivered_customer_date is not null and try_cast(order_delivered_customer_date as timestamp) is null
checks.order_estimated_delivery_date 时间可解析: select order_id,order_estimated_delivery_date from base where order_estimated_delivery_date is not null and try_cast(order_estimated_delivery_date as timestamp) is null

exports.质量处置.csv: select quality,count(*) n,min(order_id) example from quality group by quality order by quality

done.title: 没填签收日期，能算晚送吗？
done.body: 想知道包裹晚了几天，需要知道买家哪天收到它。我们先按订单状态数一遍，看看哪些单本该有这个日期。

tables.sql: select case when order_status='delivered' then '已送达' else '其他状态' end 状态,count(*) 订单数,sum(order_delivered_customer_date is null) 缺签收 from quality group by 1
select order_id 订单号,order_status 状态,order_delivered_customer_date 签收 from quality where quality='missing_actual' limit 3

done.lesson: 状态写着“已送达”却缺日期的订单仍保存在总表。比较准时和晚送时把它们单独放下。

stages.name: 4 构造变量与样本
sql: create table candidates as select *,date_diff('second',order_purchase_timestamp,order_delivered_customer_date)/86400.0 delivery_days,(cast(order_delivered_customer_date as date)>cast(order_estimated_delivery_date as date))::int late_day,(order_delivered_customer_date>order_estimated_delivery_date)::int late_clock,(quality='eligible' and score is not null)::int rated from quality

exports.口径比较.csv: select sum(rated) denominator,sum(late_day) late_day_n,sum(late_clock) late_clock_n,sum(late_day!=late_clock) switched,min(case when late_day!=late_clock then order_id end) example from candidates where rated=1
exports.样本筛选.csv: select count(*) all_orders,sum(order_status='delivered') delivered,sum(quality='eligible') fulfillment,sum(rated) rated from candidates

done.title: 从所有订单里，挑出能回答问题的那些单
done.body: 从第一行往下读：先找已送达的单，再要求有足够日期判断准时与否，最后要求买家给过分。右列显示这一步少了多少单。

tables.sql: with n as (select count(*) a,sum(order_status='delivered') b,sum(quality='eligible') c,sum(rated) d from candidates) select '① 所有订单' 筛选步骤,a 保留订单,0 本步排除 from n union all select '  ② 已送达',b,a-b from n union all select '    ③ 可计算履约',c,b-c from n union all select '      ④ 有评分',d,c-d from n
select order_id 订单号,order_estimated_delivery_date 预计,order_delivered_customer_date 签收 from candidates where rated=1 and late_day!=late_clock order by order_id limit 1

done.lesson: 还剩一个决定：预计今天到、今天傍晚签收，算不算迟？下一屏由你选，后面的图表就按你的答案重算。

stages.name: 5 描述统计与探索
sql: create table analysis as select c.*,case when rated=1 then case value when 'calendar' then late_day else late_clock end end late from candidates c cross join decision
create table eda as select late,count(*) n,avg(score) mean_score,sum(score<=2) low_score_n,sum(score>=4) high_score_n from analysis where rated=1 group by late

create table post as select r.order_id,avg(cast(review_score as real)) post_score from reviews r join orders o using(order_id) where review_answer_timestamp>=order_delivered_customer_date group by r.order_id

create table branches as select 'A' branch,order_id,late,score from analysis where rated=1 union all select 'B',a.order_id,late,score from analysis a join post using(order_id) where rated=1 union all select 'C',a.order_id,late,post_score from analysis a join post using(order_id) where rated=1

checks.两组分母覆盖分析样本: select sum(n) from eda having sum(n)!=(select sum(rated) from analysis) or (select count(*) from analysis where rated=1 and late is null)>0

exports.分析数据.csv.gz: select * from analysis order by order_id
exports.图表底表.csv: select * from eda order by late
exports.评分分布.csv: select late,score,count(*) n from analysis where rated=1 group by late,score order by late,score
exports.边界记录.csv: select order_id,order_delivered_customer_date,order_estimated_delivery_date,late_day,late_clock,score,late from analysis where rated=1 and late_day!=late_clock order by order_id limit 3
exports.探索对照.csv: select branch,late,count(*) n,avg(score) mean_score from branches group by branch,late order by branch,late

done.title: 准时到的包裹和晚到的包裹，各得了几分？
done.body: 一单有多条评价时，先算这一单的平均分。再让每单占一票，分别计算两组的平均分。

tables.sql: with g as (select branch,sum(late=0) n0,sum(late=1) n1,avg(case when late=0 then score end) a,avg(case when late=1 then score end) b from branches group by branch) select *,a-b gap from g where branch='A'
tables.explain: 准时的 {n0:,} 单平均 {a:.2f} 分；晚送的 {n1:,} 单平均 {b:.2f} 分。两组相差 {gap:.3f} 分。

done.lesson: 有些买家在包裹送到之前就给了分。如果只看收货后的评价，差距还会这么大吗？

done.title: 只看收货后的评价，发生了什么？
done.body: 程序对照了评价时间和签收时间。没有收货后评价的订单先放下；留下的订单，只用收货后给的分。

tables.sql: with g as (select branch,sum(late=0) n0,sum(late=1) n1,avg(case when late=0 then score end) a,avg(case when late=1 then score end) b from branches group by branch) select *,a-b gap from g where branch='C'
tables.explain: 这次还剩 {n0:,} 单准时、{n1:,} 单晚送。准时组平均 {a:.2f} 分，晚送组 {b:.2f} 分，相差 {gap:.3f} 分。

done.lesson: 刚才同时改了两件事：留下哪些订单，以及每单用哪些评分。下一步拿同一批订单算两遍，把两个原因拆开。

done.title: 差距为什么变小了？
done.body: 下表每行都用「准时组平均分减去晚送组平均分」。先换订单，再换评分。

tables.sql: with g as (select branch,sum(late=0) n0,sum(late=1) n1,avg(case when late=0 then score end) a,avg(case when late=1 then score end) b from branches group by branch) select case branch when 'A' then '所有能比较的订单' when 'B' then '仅留有收货后评价的单' else '沿用上一行的订单' end 用哪些订单,case branch when 'C' then '仅收货后' else '所有评价' end 用哪些评分,round(a-b,3) 相差几分 from g order by branch

with g as (select branch,sum(late=0) n0,sum(late=1) n1,avg(case when late=0 then score end) a,avg(case when late=1 then score end) b from branches group by branch) select x.a-x.b original,y.a-y.b fixed,z.a-z.b post from g x,g y,g z where x.branch='A' and y.branch='B' and z.branch='C'
tables.explain: 只换订单，差距就从 {original:.3f} 降到 {fixed:.3f} 分。保留这些订单再换评分，差距是 {post:.3f} 分。这批数据里，变化主要来自哪些订单被留下。

tables.sql: select count(*) as B与C成员不一致订单数 from (select order_id from branches where branch in ('B','C') group by order_id having count(distinct branch)!=2)

done.lesson: 这说明两组顾客打分有差别。单凭这次比较，还不能断定包裹晚到导致了多少分的下降。

guide.title: 一次网购，从下单到打分　·　巴西 Olist 订单
guide.opening: 假如你买了两件商品，最后给这笔订单打了几分？
guide.context: Olist 是巴西的电商平台。这批数据记录了买家下单、买了什么、怎样付款，以及后来给了几分。顾客评分从 1 到 5，5 分最高。
guide.route: 我们先把同一单的记录找齐，判断包裹有没有晚到，再把准时和晚送的订单分开算平均分。
steps: 找出缺少签收日期的订单
